# this is the build file for project 
# it is autogenerated by the xmake build system.
# do not edit by hand.

# project
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15.0)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0091 NEW)
project(anchor LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CURRENT_COMPILER_ID ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID})
set(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT})
if(NOT CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT)
    if(MSVC)
        set(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT "MSVC")
    else()
        set(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT "GNU")
    endif()
endif()
if(DEFINED CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT)
    set(CURRENT_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT})
endif()
if(NOT CURRENT_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT)
    set(CURRENT_LINKER_FRONTEND_VARIANT ${CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT})
endif()

# target
add_library(anchor SHARED "")
set_target_properties(anchor PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "anchor")
set_target_properties(anchor PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux/x86_64/debug")
target_include_directories(anchor PRIVATE
    include
    src
)
target_compile_options(anchor PRIVATE
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-m64>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-m64>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-G>
)
set_target_properties(anchor PROPERTIES C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
target_compile_features(anchor PRIVATE c_std_17)
set_target_properties(anchor PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
target_compile_features(anchor PRIVATE cxx_std_23)
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
    target_compile_options(anchor PRIVATE $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-Od>)
else()
    target_compile_options(anchor PRIVATE -O0)
endif()
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
    target_compile_options(anchor PRIVATE -Zi)
else()
    target_compile_options(anchor PRIVATE -g)
endif()
if(CURRENT_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
    set_property(TARGET anchor PROPERTY
        MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
endif()
target_link_options(anchor PRIVATE
    -m64
)
# private sourcefiles from sourcebatch c++.build for target anchor
target_sources(anchor PRIVATE 
    src/demo.cc
)
